question: Which of the following animals has a three-chambered heart?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Salamander**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• **Salamanders** are amphibians and possess a three-chambered heart, consisting of two atria and one ventricle.
 
• Amphibians, in general, have a three-chambered heart which allows for a partial separation of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood.
 
• This type of heart is less efficient than the four-chambered heart found in mammals and birds, but it is sufficient for the metabolic needs of amphibians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Fish** like the Rohu have a two-chambered heart, consisting of one atrium and one ventricle.
 
• **Birds** like the Sparrow and **mammals** have a four-chambered heart, which is the most efficient for oxygenating blood.
 
• **Sting Rays**, being cartilaginous fish, also have a two-chambered heart.
